title: Beetle God on Dark Mound
description: A multi-armed humanoid figure with a large black beetle for a head stands atop a mound covered in golden rings and crawling insects. The figure holds various objects including scrolls, a bottle, and chains, while surrounded by hooded cloaked figures, floating orbs, and swirling dark smoke.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a shirtless multi-armed humanoid with pale skin covered in tattoos, wearing a large black beetle as a head, standing atop a black mound swarming with insects and scattered golden rings. The figure has six arms holding scrolls, a bottle, chains, and other objects. In the background, several hooded cloaked figures stand amid swirling black smoke, glowing golden orbs, and floating symbols, rendered in detailed ink and wash style with dramatic lighting.
